name: tash
long_description:
tash (www.tash.cards) is building the investment platform for sports and trading cards. We create professionally constructed portfolios of iconic, investment-grade cards, giving investors exposure to the asset class without the hassle of selecting, buying, storing, and selling individual cards.

Trading card investing remains fragmented, opaque, and difficult to access. tash is building the infrastructure to make the asset class simpler, more transparent, and professionally managed. We are currently pursuing SEC qualification to launch regulated investment offerings backed by trading cards.
one_liner: The investment platform for sports & trading cards
